subject: Web Development
title: The Fediverse and ActivityPub
description: A quick win: understand The Fediverse and ActivityPub.

hook.text: Mastodon lets you join one server but follow users on any other server in the network.

buildup.text: The Fediverse connects independent servers using ActivityPub, an open protocol for social media.

discovery.text: No single company controls the network. Each server sets its own rules and moderation policies.

twist.text: Meta's Threads adopted ActivityPub, bringing a corporate giant into the decentralized ecosystem.

climax.text: The Fediverse proves that social media can work without a single company owning the platform.

punchline.text: Social media without a single owner exists.
